class.name: MarginContainer
class.brief_description: A container that keeps a margin around its child controls.

members.member: How the margins take [method DisplayServer.get_display_safe_area] into account, so the content isn't covered by display cutouts or system bars, or extends under them. See [enum SafeArea]. The margins are updated when the container is resized or moved and when [signal DisplayServer.safe_area_changed] is emitted. [b]Note:[/b] This is meant for containers that stay in place, like the root of a screen. In a container that moves, for example in a [ScrollContainer] or during an animation, the margins change as it enters or leaves the unsafe area, which moves its children. [b]Note:[/b] The safe area is only taken into account on Android and iOS. In the editor and on other platforms, only the theme margins are used.

constants.constant: Only the theme margins are used.
Keeps the children inside the safe area. On each side, the margin is the larger of the theme margin and the part of the unsafe area that overlaps this container.

Extends the children outside of this container up to the screen edge on each side where the container touches or crosses the safe area edge, for example to draw a background under the status bar. On other sides, only the theme margins are used.

theme_items.theme_item: Offsets towards the inside direct children of the container by this amount of pixels from the bottom.
